answer: Epoch 122 gives weight only to an identity whose banded raven makes one summit flight, since raven hours are the scarce input and one bird flies one route at a time. At dawn the summit tank etches that day's ripple pattern onto a token, carried by the raven in a pouch to the registry in 2 hours. Clerks scan band and pattern and check flight time against the wind band; a token off-band or with a copied ripple is provable reuse, voiding the identity and its $90 bond. An honest agent pays $90 once; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 ravens and $90,000, and one bird's 6-month training cannot be parallelised.
